title: Top 5 Most MASSIVE Black Holes In The Universe
hook: Number one is over 60 billion Suns.

items.name: Sagittarius A*
items.stat: Our galaxy's central black hole weighs about 4.3 million Suns.
items.query: Sagittarius A star Event Horizon Telescope

items.name: M87*
items.stat: The first black hole ever imaged holds about 6.5 billion solar masses.
items.query: M87 black hole Event Horizon Telescope

items.name: NGC 1277 Black Hole
items.stat: This monster is roughly 17 billion Suns — about 14% of its galaxy's mass.

items.name: TON 618
items.stat: This quasar's black hole is estimated at a staggering 40 billion solar masses.

items.name: Phoenix A
items.stat: Possibly the biggest known, estimated near 100 billion solar masses.
